archetype: ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST (Authority, Clarity, Truth) & Mobile-First Operations

screens.name: Login Screen
screens.description: Authentication screen with employee ID / username, password, and quick-fill demo account buttons (Owner, Engineer, PM, PCM).

screens.name: Dashboard & Financial Summary
screens.description: Project profitability metrics, PO value vs actual cost, cost budget utilization, project financial summary table, monthly cost trends, cost by project, user, and category.

screens.name: PO Project Management
screens.description: List of active POs (Moratel DWDM, Moratel OLT), PO amounts, actual costs, cost utilization percentages, and add PO action.

screens.name: Operational Cost Tracker
screens.description: Form for submitting daily operational expenses categorized by Makan, Penginapan, Transport, Others, with amount and keterangan.

screens.name: Approvals & Transactions
screens.description: Transaction history and PM approval queue for operational costs submitted by engineers and PCMs.

screens.name: User Profile & Management
screens.description: Employee profile details, role-based editing (Owner vs Employee), salary details, and password change.

screens.name: Employee List & Salary Payment
screens.description: Directory of staff (Budi, Citra, Deni, Eka) with monthly salary status tracking (Belum Dibayar / Terbayar toggle).

instructions_to_main_agent: Recreate the complete mockup flow and screens represented by the Telecony Ops Tracker HTML artifact.
Ensure bottom navigation bar switches seamlessly between Dashboard, PO Projects, Operational Tracker, Salary/Gaji, and Profile/User Management.
Include demo account quick-fill buttons on the login screen for Owner, Engineer, PM, and PCM.
Implement operational cost submission form with category pills (Makan, Penginapan, Transport, Others).
Provide salary payment status toggle (Belum / Terbayar) and project financial summary tables.
Add data-testid to all buttons, tabs, inputs, and list items.
